title: Connecting dimensions, fits and dimensions combinations of hands for clocks
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies a series of preferred dimensions for the holes of clocks hands with a view to achieve type reduction for the benefit of both manufacturers and purchasers.
clause_3_terminology: fits and dimensions combinations of hands for clocks
Connecting dimensions, fits and dimensions combinations of hands for clocks

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
